params.body:
Documentation only. Adds a short paragraph to the README on what `elixir:control-service` does when the IAP tunnel does not open, and what to do when that is not enough.

The code side of this was already merged as #240: the tunnel runs with its own `CLOUDSDK_CONFIG` under the control directory, a corrupt `.db` there is set aside (never deleted), and the last `ERROR` line of `tunnel.log` reaches the job note in Portal. What was missing is the runbook pointer: `tail -n 40 tunnel.log`, `php artisan elixir:control-service --status`, then the recovery plan in abovebeyond `docs/incidents/2026-10-09-control-gateway-tunnel.md`.

No behaviour changes; merging deploys only the README.
params.title: README: what to do when the control tunnel does not open
